content.text:
* Two-stage NMOS-input OTA with cascoded input drains.
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* External 10uA reference and ground-referenced mirrors.
XREF IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XTAIL NS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=30 l=1 nf=1 m=2
XOSINK VOUT IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=1 nf=1 m=4
* Differential input; the nondiode leg is noninverting overall.
XINP NP VINP NS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=2
XINN NN VINN NS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=2
XCASP NG NCAS NP VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=2
XCASN ND NCAS NN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=2
XPD PDL ND VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=75 l=0.5 nf=1 m=2
XPM PML ND VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=75 l=0.5 nf=1 m=2
XPCD ND PCAS PDL VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XPCM NG PCAS PML VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
* Supply-relative PMOS cascode reference.
XPR PCAS PCAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XPRS PCAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1 m=1
* Cascode reference: two diode drops with low-density upper device.
XCBP NCAS ND VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=50 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XCBU NCAS NCAS NCB VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XCBL NCB NCB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
* PMOS common-source output and zero-compensated Miller network.
XOUT VOUT NG VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=10
RZ NG NZ 1600
CC NZ VOUT 4.5p
.ends DUT
